```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(lubridate)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)
```


```{r}
covid_df =
read.csv("data/covid_19.csv")

clean_covid_df =
  covid_df |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    date = lubridate::mdy(date_of_interest),
    case_count = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", case_count)),
    case_count_7day_avg = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", case_count_7day_avg)),
    hospitalized_count = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", hospitalized_count)),
    death_count = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", death_count))
  ) |>
  arrange(date)

events = tibble(
  event = c("Lockdown", "Vaccine rollout", "Omicron surge"),
  start = as.Date(c("2020-03-15", "2020-12-14", "2021-12-01")),
  end   = as.Date(c("2020-06-15", "2021-03-01", "2022-02-15"))
)

max_y <- max(clean_covid_df$case_count, na.rm = TRUE)

nyc_weather =
read.csv("data/nyc_weather.csv")


weather_df =
  nyc_weather |> 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    year = lubridate::year(date),
    month = lubridate::month(date),
    month = case_match(month,
                       1 ~ "January",
                       2 ~ "February",
                       3 ~ "March", 
                       4 ~ "April",
                       5 ~ "May",
                       6 ~ "June",
                       7 ~ "July",
                       8 ~ "August",
                       9 ~ "September", 
                       10 ~ "October",
                       11 ~ "November",
                       12 ~ "December"
    ),
    tmin_c = tmin / 10,
    tmax_c = tmax / 10,
    average_temp = (tmin_c + tmax_c) / 2,
  ) |> 
  filter(year %in% c(2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025))


daily_mta = 
  read.csv("data/mta.csv")

monthly_mta =
  read.csv("data/monthly_mta.csv")

monthly_pre =
  monthly_mta |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(month),
    year = year(date),
    month_num = month(date),
    month_name = month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
    ridership = parse_number(ridership),

    mode = case_when(
      agency %in% c("NYCT Bus", "MTA Bus", "Bus") ~ "Bus",
      agency %in% c("Subway","MNR","LIRR","AAR","SIR") ~ agency,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    days_in_month = days_in_month(date),
    avg_daily_ridership = ridership / days_in_month
  ) |>
  filter(
    year >= 2018,
    year <= 2019,
    !is.na(mode)
  ) |>
  select(year, month_num, month_name, mode, avg_daily_ridership)

daily_mta_clean =
  daily_mta |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    date = mdy(date),
    year = year(date),
    month_num = month(date),
    month_name = month(date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
    count = parse_number(count),

    mode = case_when(
      mode %in% c("NYCT Bus", "MTA Bus", "Bus") ~ "Bus",
      mode %in% c("AAR","Subway","LIRR","MNR","SIR") ~ mode,
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  filter(year >= 2020, !is.na(mode)) |> 
  mutate(
    weekday = wday(date, label = TRUE),
    weekend = ifelse(weekday %in% c("Sat", "Sun"), "Weekend", "Weekday")
  )

monthly_post =
  daily_mta_clean |>
  group_by(year, month_num, month_name, mode) |>
  summarise(
    avg_daily_ridership = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

full_mta =
  bind_rows(monthly_pre, monthly_post) |>
  arrange(year, month_num, mode) |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(paste(year, month_num, "01", sep = "-")),
    period = case_when(
      year < 2020 ~ "Pre-Pandemic",
      year == 2020 & month_num <= 2 ~ "Pre-Pandemic",
      year == 2020 & month_num >= 3 ~ "Pandemic",
      year == 2021 ~ "Pandemic",
      year >= 2022 ~ "Post-Pandemic"),
    period = factor(period, levels = c("Pre-Pandemic", "Pandemic", "Post-Pandemic"))
  )

monthly_modes =
  full_mta |>
  mutate(
    mode_group = case_when(
      mode == "Bus"    ~ "Bus",
      mode == "Subway" ~ "Subway",
      TRUE             ~ "Other"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(date, mode_group) |>
  summarise(
    ridership = sum(avg_daily_ridership, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

recovery =
  full_mta |>
  mutate(
    mode_group = case_when(
      mode == "Bus"    ~ "Bus",
      mode == "Subway" ~ "Subway",
      TRUE             ~ "Other"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(mode_group) |>
  mutate(
    baseline_2018 = mean(avg_daily_ridership[year == 2018], na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_of_2018   = avg_daily_ridership / baseline_2018
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(date >= as.Date("2020-06-01"))


```

### NYC MTA Ridership and COVID-19 Cases

```{r}
# Average daily MTA Ridership 
ridership_modes =
  full_mta |>
  mutate(
    mode_group = case_when(
      mode == "Bus"    ~ "Bus",
      mode == "Subway" ~ "Subway",
      TRUE             ~ "Other"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(date, mode_group) |>
  summarise(
    avg_daily_ridership = sum(avg_daily_ridership, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ridership_plot =
  ridership_modes |>
  plot_ly(
    x     = ~date,
    y     = ~avg_daily_ridership,
    color = ~mode_group,
    colors = c("Bus" = "#e74c3c", "Subway" = "#3498db", "Other" = "#95a5a6"),
    name  = ~mode_group,
    legendgroup = ~mode_group,
    type  = "scatter",
    mode  = "lines",
    line  = list(width = 2)
  ) |>
  layout(
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Average Daily Ridership",
      separatethousands = TRUE
    ),
    xaxis = list(title = ""),
    showlegend = TRUE,
    legend = list(
      orientation = "h",
      xanchor = "center",
      x = 0.5,
      y = -0.1
    ),
    margin = list(b = 40, t = 10)
  )

# COVID Daily PLOT visualization
covid_daily_plot =
  clean_covid_df |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~date,
    y = ~case_count,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines",
    line = list(color = "firebrick", width = 1.5),
    showlegend = FALSE   
  ) |>
  layout(
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Daily COVID-19 Cases (log scale)",
      type  = "log",
      separatethousands = TRUE
    ),
    xaxis = list(title = "Date"),
    shapes = lapply(1:nrow(events), function(i) {
      list(
        type = "rect",
        xref = "x",
        x0 = events$start[i],
        x1 = events$end[i],
        yref = "paper",
        y0 = 0,
        y1 = 1,
        fillcolor = "rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.15)",
        line = list(width = 0),
        layer = "below"
      )
    }),
    annotations = lapply(1:nrow(events), function(i) {
      list(
        x = events$start[i] + (events$end[i] - events$start[i]) / 2,
        y = 1.05,
        xref = "x",
        yref = "paper",
        text = events$event[i],
        showarrow = FALSE,
        font = list(size = 11)
      )
    }),
    margin = list(t = 50, b = 50)
  )

final_figure =
  subplot(
    ridership_plot,
    covid_daily_plot,
    nrows   = 2,
    shareX  = TRUE,
    titleX  = TRUE,
    titleY  = TRUE,
    heights = c(0.50, 0.50),
    margin = 0.08
  ) |>
  layout(
    hovermode = "x unified"
  )

final_figure
```

### MTA Ridership at Key Phases Compared to 2018 Baseline

```{r}
monthly_modes =
  full_mta |>
  mutate(
    mode_group = case_when(
      mode == "Bus"    ~ "Bus",
      mode == "Subway" ~ "Subway",
      TRUE             ~ "Other"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(date, mode_group) |>
  summarise(
    ridership = sum(avg_daily_ridership, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

monthly_covid =
  clean_covid_df |>
  mutate(month = as.Date(cut(date, "month"))) |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarise(
    monthly_cases = sum(case_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  rename(date = month)

monthly_joined =
  monthly_modes |>
  left_join(monthly_covid, by = "date")

monthly_surge =
  monthly_joined |>
  mutate(
    surge_period = case_when(
      date >= as.Date("2020-03-01") & date <= as.Date("2020-06-01") ~ "Lockdown wave",
      date >= as.Date("2020-12-01") & date <= as.Date("2021-03-01") ~ "Vaccine-rollout wave",
      date >= as.Date("2021-12-01") & date <= as.Date("2022-02-01") ~ "Omicron surge",
      TRUE ~ "Other months"
    )
  )

monthly_surge_filtered =
  monthly_surge |> 
  filter(surge_period != "Other months") |> 
  mutate(
    surge_period = factor(surge_period,
                          levels = c("Lockdown wave",
                                     "Vaccine-rollout wave",
                                     "Omicron surge"))
  )

baseline_2018 =
  monthly_surge |>  
  filter(year(date) == 2018) |>
  group_by(mode_group) |>
  summarise(
    baseline_2018 = mean(ridership, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

surge_summary =
  monthly_surge_filtered |>
  group_by(mode_group, surge_period) |>
  summarise(
    mean_ridership = mean(ridership, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(baseline_2018, by = "mode_group") |>
  mutate(
    pct_of_2018 = mean_ridership / baseline_2018
  )

plotly_surge =
  surge_summary |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~surge_period,
    y = ~pct_of_2018,
    color = ~mode_group,
    type = "bar",
    hovertemplate =
      "<b>%{x}</b><br>"    %+%
      "Mode: %{color}<br>" %+%
      "Ridership: %{y:.1%} of 2018<extra></extra>"
  ) |>
  layout(
    barmode = "group",
    title = list(
      text = "",
      x = 0.5
    ),
    xaxis = list(title = "COVID Surge Period"),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "% of 2018 Ridership",
      tickformat = ".0%",
      range = c(0, max(surge_summary$pct_of_2018) * 1.15)
    ),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Mode"))
  )
plotly_surge
```

### Temperature vs Ridership

```{r}
monthly_weather =
  weather_df |>
  mutate(month = as.Date(cut(date, "month"))) |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarise(
    avg_temp = mean(average_temp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  rename(date = month)

monthly_weather_mta =
  monthly_modes |>
  left_join(monthly_weather, by = "date")

# Create scatter plot for each mode
temp_ridership_plot <- plot_ly() |>
  add_trace(
    data = monthly_weather_mta |> filter(mode_group == "Subway"),
    x = ~avg_temp,
    y = ~ridership,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    name = "Subway",
    marker = list(color = "#3498db", size = 6, opacity = 0.6),
    hovertemplate = paste(
      "<b>Subway</b><br>",
      "Temperature: %{x:.1f}°C<br>",
      "Ridership: %{y:,.0f}<br>",
      "<extra></extra>"
    )
  ) |>
  add_trace(
    data = monthly_weather_mta |> filter(mode_group == "Bus"),
    x = ~avg_temp,
    y = ~ridership,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    name = "Bus",
    marker = list(color = "#e74c3c", size = 6, opacity = 0.6),
    hovertemplate = paste(
      "<b>Bus</b><br>",
      "Temperature: %{x:.1f}°C<br>",
      "Ridership: %{y:,.0f}<br>",
      "<extra></extra>"
    )
  ) |>
  add_trace(
    data = monthly_weather_mta |> filter(mode_group == "Other"),
    x = ~avg_temp,
    y = ~ridership,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    name = "Other",
    marker = list(color = "#95a5a6", size = 6, opacity = 0.6),
    hovertemplate = paste(
      "<b>Other</b><br>",
      "Temperature: %{x:.1f}°C<br>",
      "Ridership: %{y:,.0f}<br>",
      "<extra></extra>"
    )
  )

# Add loess smoothing lines for each mode
for (mode in c("Subway", "Bus", "Other")) {
  mode_data <- monthly_weather_mta |> filter(mode_group == mode)
  
  if (nrow(mode_data) > 5) {
    loess_fit <- loess(ridership ~ avg_temp, data = mode_data, span = 0.75)
    pred_data <- data.frame(
      avg_temp = seq(min(mode_data$avg_temp, na.rm = TRUE), 
                     max(mode_data$avg_temp, na.rm = TRUE), 
                     length.out = 100)
    )
    pred_data$ridership <- predict(loess_fit, newdata = pred_data)
    
    color <- ifelse(mode == "Subway", "#3498db", 
                    ifelse(mode == "Bus", "#e74c3c", "#95a5a6"))
    
    temp_ridership_plot <- temp_ridership_plot |>
      add_trace(
        data = pred_data,
        x = ~avg_temp,
        y = ~ridership,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines",
        line = list(color = color, width = 2.5),
        name = mode,
        showlegend = FALSE,
        hoverinfo = "skip"
      )
  }
}

temp_ridership_plot <- temp_ridership_plot |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Average Monthly Temperature (°C)",
      gridcolor = "#ecf0f1"
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Ridership",
      separatethousands = TRUE,
      gridcolor = "#ecf0f1"
    ),
    hovermode = "closest",
    legend = list(
      title = list(text = "Transit Mode"),
      orientation = "v",
      x = 1.02,
      y = 1,
      xanchor = "left"
    ),
    plot_bgcolor = "#f8f9fa",
    paper_bgcolor = "white",
    margin = list(r = 100)
  )

temp_ridership_plot
```
